title: Pack Source Mapping
description: Maps each card to the pack(s) it can be obtained from in Pokémon TCG Pocket. Built from Limitless TCG Pocket data. Do not fabricate entries.

_meta.description: Metadata about this file: when it was generated, source, notes.

set_code.description: Set code as used by Limitless TCG Pocket (e.g. A1, A4b, B1, B3)

pack_name.description: Pack within the set this card drops from (null = shared across all packs in expansion)

expansion.description: Expansion name (e.g. Mega Rising, Fantastical Parade)

card_category.description: Card category from external reference (Pokemon, Item, Supporter, etc.)

pokemon_type.description: Pokémon type (Fire, Water, etc.) from external reference

is_ex.description: EX status from ext_ref. Deprecated for collection entries (derive from name suffix ' ex') but retained in pack_sources for completeness.

is_promo.description: True if this card is a promo / not obtainable from standard packs

source_url.description: Limitless TCG Pocket card page URL

confidence.description: Confidence: high=pack label in HTML, medium=inferred from expansion, low=unknown

notes.description: Any notes about availability, exclusivity, or data quality
